import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        Arrays.sort(a);
        int ans = 0;
        int l = 0, r = 0;
        while (r < n) {
            if (a[r] - a[l] <= T) {
                ans = Math.max(ans, r - l + 1);
                r++;
            } else {
                l++;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
